verdict.rationale: gstack's own skills generate AI insights and suggestions from the user's project artifacts. These include diff review flagging SQL safety and trust-boundary issues, design reviews that score each dimension 0-10 and explain what a 10 looks like, security findings, QA health scores with ship-readiness summaries, and accumulated learnings you can review and search. A community user reports AI-drafted answers to their product and engineering questions and better code quality. Missing for 10: insights over general business or user data (beyond code, plans and session learnings), and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
